chunks: And the trumpet will be blown: that is the Day of Doom.

key_terms.الصُّور: The trumpet blown by the angel Israfil to signal resurrection
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ: The Day of Doom/Warning, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the trumpet blast in the Day of Judgment according to Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Qaf is often linked with the first trumpet blast that causes all creatures to perish, setting the stage for the resurrection. It emphasizes the certainty of the 'Day of Warning' as a pivotal moment where divine promises are fulfilled, reinforcing the concept of bodily resurrection and the final reckoning.
